heading: Recursion
text: A recursive function calls itself on a smaller input until it reaches a base case.

heading: Trees
text: A tree is a hierarchical structure of nodes connected by edges, with a single root.

heading: Binary Trees
text: A binary tree is a tree in which each node has at most two children. Traversals are defined recursively.

heading: Binary Search Trees
text: A binary search tree is a binary tree in which values smaller than the root are stored in the left subtree and larger values in the right subtree.

heading: AVL Trees
text: An AVL tree is a self-balancing binary search tree. After each insert, rotations restore the height balance while preserving the BST ordering.

heading: Graphs
text: A graph generalises a tree: nodes connected by edges, possibly with cycles and no root.
